title: Files
connectHint: Connect a cloud account to manage its files here. Your private storage remains available independently.
oauthHint: Use your registered Google or Microsoft web application. Add the displayed callback URL and file permissions in the developer console, then authorize file access at the provider. Your calendar connection remains unchanged.
oauthOtherAddress: Save the setup, open webmail at this address and connect your cloud there:
accessAppHint: A dedicated Drive folder for files uploaded through post. Existing files outside this folder are not shown.
accessAllHint: You authorize reading, creating, changing and deleting throughout your Drive. Google may require additional app verification.
disconnectHint: Remove the connection to {{name}}? Files at the provider remain intact. You can also revoke access in your Google or Microsoft account.
encryptedHint: Local file contents are encrypted on your server. Cloud files stay with your provider.
demoHint: Demo files last only for this browser session. Sign in with your mailbox for permanent storage.
demoOAuth: Cloud connections require a signed-in mailbox and are unavailable in demo mode.
name: Name
previewHint: No preview is available for this file. Download it or open it at the provider. Google documents download as PDF.
dropHint: Drag files or entire folders here, or select them with Upload.
emptyTrashHint: Deleted files and folders appear here for restoration.
selectionHint: CTRL: Multiple selection · SHIFT: Select range · Double-click: Open
cancelHint: Saved files remain intact. An ongoing transfer to the cloud finishes first.
confirmTrash: Move {{count}} items to trash? For cloud files this also affects your provider's storage and other devices.
confirmPurge: Permanently delete {{count}} items and their contents from private storage? This cannot be undone.
moveHint: Select a destination folder for {{count}} items. Items move within the current storage.

errors.name: Use valid file or folder names without slashes or characters such as : * ? and without a trailing period.
errors.depth: The folder tree is too deep or contains too many entries (up to 40 levels and 10,000 upload entries).
errors.notFound: This item is unavailable. Refresh the view.
errors.notFolder: The destination is not an available folder.
errors.conflict: An item with this name already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
errors.cycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.
errors.size: The file exceeds the configured upload limit.
errors.quota: Insufficient storage or quota. Local files in trash still count towards usage.
errors.busy: Please wait for the current operation to finish.
errors.chunk: The transfer is incomplete or file parts arrived out of order. Upload again.
errors.corrupt: The file could not be safely decrypted. Check the data volume and encryption key.
errors.interrupted: A server restart interrupted saving. Check the destination and upload again if needed.
errors.remote: The file operation failed. Refresh and try again.
errors.remoteAuth: The provider denied file access. Check permissions and reconnect.
errors.timeout: The transfer took too long. Try again.
errors.rate: The provider received too many requests. Wait briefly.
errors.providerTrash: Manage OneDrive's recycle bin and restoration directly at OneDrive.
errors.preview: No preview is available (images and text up to 10 MB).
errors.upload: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.connect: Unable to connect. Check file permissions, the enabled Drive API and callback URL.
